components.name: Finite precision transport branching and structured interaction complexity
components.project_addition: After contextual congruence closure fixes the minimum persistent exact state, define the finite worst-cell coarse-output branching B_E(mu) as the exact minimum deterministic one-message correction-token alphabet when the decoder already knows the raw coarse input tuple. Derive integer fixed-length bit cost, operation-tree submultiplicative branching, contextual-detail upper bounds, and sharp radix examples separating minimum persistent remainder detail from operation-specific transport: addition has B=2 while multiplication has B=r^2. The stronger classification of structured, representation-stable, composable transport laws and fusion gains remains open.
